idlePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original StarCraft Goliath combat walker PILOT communication portrait, square 1:1, readable at 96 pixels. Image 1 is the existing classic Goliath pilot reference for recognizable equipment silhouette only, not a picture to copy pixel-for-pixel. Image 2 is an existing generated portrait, use ONLY its dark teal/amber game lighting/material rendering style; its robot skull face is WRONG and must not be carried into the new design. Create a newly rendered original cinematic portrait with the classic Goliath pilot identity: a HUMAN OPERATOR fully enclosed in a tall olive-drab armored flight helmet, a vertical muted brown center strip, two large ROUND green-tinted goggle eyepieces (circular lenses, NOT slanted glowing robot eyes), a long rigid central respirator nosepiece and twin round/segmented cheek breathing filters with short hoses. Preserve strongly the tall dome + paired round goggles + oxygen mask visual grammar seen in image 1. The helmet and respirator are wearable equipment enclosing a human, not an android skull; do not expose a face or invent wounds. Frontal head and upper harnessed chest seated in a Goliath walker cockpit, pilot occupies 65% frame height and 60% width. Cockpit structural rails and two softly luminous side displays frame the pilot; camera is inside cockpit looking at operator, not outside looking into a giant exosuit. Neutral attentive pose, shoulders level, visor toward viewer. Original panel seams and harness arrangement, restrained clean olive-gray metal and rubber, subtle warm lower cockpit lights, cool monitor fill, military SC2 cinematic realism compatible with current battle portraits. No oversized Marine shoulder armor, no Thor pilot, no robot skull/teeth, no weapon aimed at viewer, no giant mech chest enclosing tiny head, no scars/blood/dirt, no logos/text/UI/frame. One portrait only, not collage or animation sheet.
editBase: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single square StarCraft Goliath human walker pilot communication portrait action KEYFRAME. The reference image is the exact edit target and approved identity baseline. Preserve identically the human operator's eyes, tall olive-green armored helmet with muted brown central vertical strip and two dark bordering strips, the TWO round green goggles, central long respirator nose piece, paired cheek filters and short hoses, circular lower breathing valve, neck seal, chest harness and buckles. Exactly same wearable equipment geometry, material, wear pattern and colors; no new damage, dirt, wounds, scars, broken visor, blood, weapons or exposed face. Do not turn the helmet into a robotic skull, do not change round goggles into slanted eyes. Fixed camera/framing/scale/background: cockpit rails, left and right monitors and amber lower instrument lights remain stationary; character's head and torso move physically inside cockpit. Clearly distinct physical pose at 96px, not color/glow-only variants. Keep gritty SC2 cinematic render quality matching baseline. No text, UI, borders or panels. One image.

states.prompt: Unit selected, acknowledging the operator: physically turn helmet/head 18 degrees toward viewer RIGHT and tilt 5 degrees upward; shoulders turn only 5 degrees. Look at the right cockpit display then toward interlocutor through same goggles; slight attentive neck extension. The near/far round goggle size and side respirator perspective should visibly differ. Shoulder harness remains anchored, cockpit static. No mouth gesture; mask closed.

Attack order execution: head pitches DOWN 13 degrees and neck leans forward decisively, shoulders brace upward and forward while chest harness tightens; human eyes through goggles look forward/up toward targeting field. Clear frontal foreshortened high dome and lower goggle eye-line versus idle. Cockpit stays fixed, no muzzle flashes, weapons, or new objects. Do not just change lights.

Damage alert reaction, without injury or permanent cosmetic damage: human pilot recoils BACK into seat, head rolls 16 degrees toward viewer LEFT with a slight 8-degree left turn, near shoulder rises, opposite shoulder drops, chest remains held by harness. Human eyes glance toward a side instrument, posture concerned and braced. Helmet, respirator, goggles, glass, surface wear and cockpit stay intact exactly as baseline. Clear diagonally tilted helmet silhouette, not a camera tilt. No blood, scars, sparks, smoke, new cracks or dirt.

sourceReferenceRole: Existing local classic portrait for equipment identity; existing generated fallback for style only; generated assets are not copied original game media.
